The '''Baldur system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] that was located within the [[Nojic sector/Legends|Nojic sector]],<ref name="EAOC" /> a part of the [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] regions known as [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]]<ref name="TEA" /> and the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]].<ref name="EAOC" /> The system shared its name with conflict known as the [[Balduran Civil War]].<ref name="DS">[[Death Star (novel)|''Death Star'']]</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Baldur system was first mentioned in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', written by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Daniel Wallace]], which placed the system in grid square P-9.<ref name="TEA" />
